alivecombat.configuration.title: AliveCombat Configuration
alivecombat.configuration.autoAttackMode:
CLICK: Triggers a short burst of automatic attacks after pressing the attack key.
PRESS: Performs continuous automatic attacks while holding the attack key.
alivecombat.configuration.autoAttackDura:
In CLICK mode, the duration of auto attacks.
Measured in game ticks.
alivecombat.configuration.autoAttackFast: In PRESS mode, attack immediately when the cooldown is complete, sacrificing a small amount of damage for faster attacks.
alivecombat.configuration.passCollisionl: Pass Through Collisionless Blocks While Holding Tool
Enables targeting through collisionless blocks while holding a tool.
Pass Through Collisionless Blocks When Interaction Blocked
Enables targeting through collisionless blocks when interaction is blocked.
alivecombat.configuration.passAllyHoldin: Pass Through Allies While Holding Tool
Enables targeting through allied entities while holding a tool.
alivecombat.configuration.passAllyIntera: Pass Through Allies When Interaction Blocked
Enables targeting through allied entities when interaction is blocked.
alivecombat.configuration.autoAttackEnab: Allows holding or pressing the attack key to automatically attack the targeted entity.
alivecombat.configuration.spamAttackEnab: Prevents losing attack strength when an attack misses.
alivecombat.configuration.heldAttackEnab: Allows attacking while using items (except shields).
alivecombat.configuration.passCollisionl: Allows targeting through blocks without collision to hit entities behind them.
Allows additional targeting through collisionless blocks to reach obscured targets.
alivecombat.configuration.passDeadEnable: Allows targeting through entities in their death animation to hit targets behind them.
alivecombat.configuration.passAllyEnable: Allows targeting through allied entities to hit targets behind them.
alivecombat.configuration.attackParticle: Generates improved sweep attack particles when using melee weapons.
alivecombat.configuration.smoothIndicato: Adds frame interpolation to the attack indicator animation for smoother visuals.
alivecombat.configuration.chargeIndicato: Adds an attack indicator to ranged weapons to display charge progress.
